svg.aria-label: A sphere's cross-section with the normal at a point 45 degrees up, (0.71, 0.71). After scale(1, 0.5, 1) the surface there is flatter: its true normal is 63 degrees up, (0.45, 0.89), while the model matrix gives 27 degrees up, (0.89, 0.45), tilted the wrong way.
svg.title: A sphere's cross-section with the normal at a point 45 degrees up, (0.71, 0.71). After scale(1, 0.5, 1) the surface there is flatter: its true normal is 63 degrees up, (0.45, 0.89), while the model matrix gives 27 degrees up, (0.89, 0.45), tilted the wrong way.
